g.text: Ambient · AON-1 (Ambient Orbital Node 1) 3U CubeSat · rev A
UNLESS NOTED: LINEAR X.X ±0.1 [±.004] · X.XX ±0.05 [±.002] · HOLES +0.1/-0 · ANGLES ±0.5° · THREADS ISO 965 6H · THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION · BREAK EDGES 0.5 · ASME Y14.5

svg.text: STEP 1: -Z FRAME, SWITCH BRACKETS, SWITCHES
1. Fit AON-106 brackets to the -Z frame W taps with H4 (0.20 N·m). Hang SW1/SW2 (BP-03) on the brackets with H5
(0.10 N·m). Check the lever travel by hand.
2. CHECK: levers free; switch clicks at 0.5 mm
STEP 2: RAILS TO THE -Z FRAME
1. Stand the four rails in a squaring fixture (100.00 gauge block box). Seat the -Z frame bar ends on the rails,
fit H1 at A1/B1 (0.45 N·m). Rails AON-101 at +X+Y and -X-Y (notch at -Z).
2. CHECK: envelope 100.0 ±0.1 at -Z; levers in the notches, 1.5 proud
STEP 3: RODS, END BOARD, LOWER STACK
1. Thread the 4 Ti rods through the -Z frame; E07 + thin nuts H3 under it. Stack spacers -01 / E02 / -02 / E01 /
-03 / E03; measure the gap to the mid frame, face spacer -04 to fit.
2. CHECK: stack connectors fully mated; gap -04 recorded
STEP 4: MID FRAME
1. Lower the mid frame between the rails over the rods; H1 at A2/B2 (0.45 N·m).
2. CHECK: rails square: diagonals equal within 0.1
STEP 5: UPPER STACK: COM
1. Spacer -05, E04, coax BP-08 routed up; measure and face spacer -06.
2. CHECK: coax bend radius ≥ 10 mm
STEP 6: +Z FRAME, ANTENNA BOARD, SPRINGS
1. Fit the +Z frame (H1 at A3/B3), standoffs H7 on the rods (0.6 N·m: this preloads the stack), E05 with H8. Screw
the spring plungers BP-04 into the AON-102 rails.
2. CHECK: spring noses 2.0 proud; rods do not turn
STEP 7: SOLAR PANELS
1. Pads H9 on the mid-frame bars. Connect each panel harness (AON-E02), then fit the panels with H2 (0.20 N·m).
E06A (RBF port) on +X.
2. CHECK: bond < 10 mΩ panel to rail; RBF fitted
Highlighted (orange tint): the parts added in that step.
Work in an ISO 8 clean area, ESD controlled; gloves; torque driver calibrated.
The same 7 steps play in the Anatomy 3D viewer (assembly.json).
